principle: Validate frozen, plan-conditioned relations rather than robot-specific part names.
universal_hard_gates: physical geometry exists and is valid
generated envelope remains commensurate with planned envelope
one rigid link has a connected load path
relational_gates: derived functional subassemblies satisfy their frozen relational contract
functional terminal members define the terminal envelope
visual_policy: A hard deterministic failure is FAIL. If hard gates pass but required multi-view visual evidence has not been reviewed, return REVIEW_REQUIRED, never PASS.
